s0.Text: This Notum Battery Tree feeds on crystals. Bring me a Crystal Filled by the Source.{completequest JS07}

s1.Text: Perfect. Take these two Prepared Notum Crystals to the Incarnators: west first, then east. {take JK02}{completequest JS08}

s1_need.Text: I need a Crystal Filled by the Source, any quality.

s2.Text: The Incarnators answer the crystals. Take this Ancient device to Dr. Hestiya in the malah camp.{completequest JS09}

s3.Text: Thieving Spirits near the Ergo cave keep stealing my Xan technology. Bring back the three pieces.{completequest JS53}

s4.Text: All three pieces. This Ring of Computing is yours. {take JK0S}{take JK0T}{take JK0U}{completequest JS55}

s4_need.Text: I need the Igneous Rock Machine Component, Advanced Alloy Fuse and Crystallized Notum Circuitry.

idle.Text: The Notum Battery Tree hums today.
